svg.title: Basket initial object-position coverage
svg.desc: Two scatter panels show the yellow and green cube starts in the same 75 selected Basket demonstration episodes: 25 Teleop and 50 Mimic. Each object uses its own selected Teleop centroid as zero, with units in millimeters and axes from minus 25 to plus 25. No jitter is added. Yellow XY population standard deviation: Teleop 11.11/12.76 mm and Mimic 10.85/11.86 mm. Green: Teleop 11.76/10.85 mm and Mimic 11.18/10.64 mm. Teleop and Mimic occupy similar initial XY ranges in this selected release. The two panels are 75 shared episodes, not 150 independent demonstrations. This is dataset coverage, not a measurement of policy generalization.
